title: Other Discoveries, 1937-8 (Remains of buildings): St. Helena's chapel, Church of the Holy Sepulchre
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
screen_term: Church of the Holy Sepulchre (Jerusalem); entry without its own heading
location_note: St. Helena's chapel in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem; placed by name.
notes: Repairs by the Armenian authorities, early 1938: two medieval stone altars, apse masonry with incised crosses, piscina, wall niche, painted Gothic names (one dated 1501). No eligible feature.
